en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with multiple medieval stone towers and dense traditional houses with steep roofs. A large round tower with crenellations stands prominently on the left atop rocky ground, a tall square church or city‑gate tower with a pointed spire rises in the center, and another cylindrical tower that resembles a water tower stands on the right. The scene shows tightly packed buildings on a slope, small gardens, and narrow streets, suggesting an old fortified city.
